financing_disposition.authority_basis: PLAN_forex_v3.md section 2 carry rules: financing modelled from policy-rate differentials with effective-date PIT semantics frozen ex ante and the approximation disclosed in the proposal, or an owner-authorized financing source

financing_disposition.pit_semantics: every financing term uses rows gated on available_time_utc (effective-date semantics above): a rate change affects financing only from its availability stamp, never its effective date alone; rate changes surface as dated vintages (append-only)
financing_disposition.beyond_differentials_verdict: INELIGIBLE — any proposal whose economics depend on financing precision beyond adopted policy-rate differentials (swap points, broker rollover, OIS/overnight curves, bid-ask financing) is INELIGIBLE absent an owner-authorized financing source
financing_disposition.dual_book_rule: every scored book carries BOTH a price-only PnL and a financing-adjusted PnL; the financing term must not manufacture the edge (price-only book must not invert the anchor's expectancy sign)
